bucket_reason: Initial observation finished with low or medium confidence in the complete mechanism; further mechanism/proof work waits under CLAUDE.md.
question: Fund one 30-minute edge-return study for the shared line 6/348 family?

options.label: Bounded mechanism study
options.consequence: Use line 6 as the canonical orientation; keep line 348 as a separate initial-state obligation. Stop at 30 minutes or the cryptid boundary; do not assume a closed invariant.

options.label: Defer this family
options.consequence: Keep the evidence and leave further research on this family paused.

rationale: Period-seven bulk and independent endpoint replays give a concrete starting point; the short evolving edge still has no closed rule.

evidence.text: Both starts exceeded five billion direct steps without halting; this is finite evidence only.

effort_if_yes: At most 30 minutes for this family; no formal proof stage funded by this decision.
